Commercial development property

A substantial, three storey commercial development property situated near the town centre and harbour. A former blacksmiths property with approximately 1,250 square feet on each floor plus garage at side. It is suitable for a variety of uses subject to the necessary planning approvals. Interested parties should make their own enquiries to Cumberland Council regarding their proposed use. Please note some of the machinery will be removed prior to completion.
